spec.scene: A narrow wooden windowsill sits on a small patch of floor, night-blue glass panes behind it. At the center a warm cream mug of tea steams gently, a little larger than life. To its left a tiny round lamp glows soft amber, and to the right a sleepy green houseplant leans in its terracotta pot. A folded gray blanket rests at the front edge, and the sill boards catch the lamp's warm light against the cool blue of the window.
spec.title: A Quiet Night
spec.caption: Nothing much happened today, and that was okay.
